name: US natural gas transmission network and North American border crossings
description: Bundled geometry for the commodity-gas-flows layer: EIA public-domain transmission linework and NACEI border-crossing points. Geometry only — every current number in this layer comes from EIA monthly filings at runtime, not from these files.
license_note: Both datasets are US and Canadian government public-domain / open-licence energy data. The pipeline linework is EIA public-domain data republished as an ArcGIS hosted VIEW owned by "Federal_User_Community" (org FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3, Esri's federal data community; item 9833ca6c8103490b8ad145a30f0522ee, created 2020-04-30, 3.6M+ views). Its item licenseInfo reads "This work is licensed under the Esri Master License Agreement" and its accessInformation credits EIA — an Esri MLA notice wrapped around public-domain federal data. It is a curated community host rather than EIA infrastructure, so the manifest counts below are asserted on every rebuild and a substitution fails loudly.

files.vintage_claim_rejected: the service advertises editingInfo.dataLastEditDate 2025-07-01, which is a re-upload stamp and is ignored here
files.hosted_by: services2.arcgis.com/FiaPA4ga0iQKduv3 — ArcGIS hosted view, owner "Federal_User_Community" (Esri federal data community), not an eia.gov endpoint
files.coverage_hole: This view serves only TYPEPIPE Interstate (17,996) and Intrastate (14,896) = 32,892. The source shapefile carries 32,961 records because it also holds 69 Gathering features, which the view filters out silently — a query for TYPEPIPE='Gathering' returns count 0. The 69-record gap is a dropped pipe class, not dropped geometry.

files.vintage_evidence: Period field holds 2017 (71 records) and 201706 (28, the Canadian NEB/ONÉ filings); the NACEI FTP carries only 201606, 201701 and 201708

reproduce.raw_archive: Pages are archived verbatim under .gev-cache/ (git-ignored). Rebuild from an archive with --replay-network <dir> / --replay-crossings <dir>; upstream_sha256 is taken over the concatenated pages and recomputed on every run.
